parameters.query: SELECT r.id AS reminder_id,r.onboarding_id,r.recipient,r.sequence_number,c.display_name AS client_name,c.primary_contact_name,it.token,string_agg(req.label,', ' ORDER BY req.label) AS missing_items FROM app.reminders r JOIN app.onboardings o ON o.id=r.onboarding_id JOIN app.clients c ON c.id=o.client_id JOIN app.intake_tokens it ON it.onboarding_id=o.id AND it.submitted_at IS NULL AND it.expires_at>now() JOIN app.requirements req ON req.onboarding_id=o.id AND req.is_blocking AND req.status NOT IN ('APPROVED','WAIVED') WHERE r.status='scheduled' AND r.scheduled_for<=now() AND o.status='AWAITING_CLIENT' GROUP BY r.id,r.onboarding_id,r.recipient,r.sequence_number,c.display_name,c.primary_contact_name,it.token ORDER BY r.scheduled_for LIMIT 100;

const link=`http://localhost:3000/intake/${$json.token}`;const subject=`Reminder: complete your onboarding questionnaire — ${$json.client_name}`;const encodedSubject=`=?UTF-8?B?${Buffer.from(subject,'utf8').toString('base64')}?=`;const html=`

CLIENT ONBOARDING REMINDER

Your kickoff is waiting on a few details.

Hello ${$json.primary_contact_name},

Please complete your secure questionnaire. The following items are still outstanding: ${$json.missing_items}.

Complete questionnaire

Do not submit passwords or secret keys.

`;const mime=[`To: ${$json.recipient}`,`Subject: ${encodedSubject}`,'MIME-Version: 1.0','Content-Type: text/html; charset=UTF-8','',html].join('\r\n');const raw=Buffer.from(mime).toString('base64').replace(/\+/g,'-').replace(/\//g,'_').replace(/=+$/,'');return[{json:{...$json,raw}}];

parameters.query: WITH updated AS (UPDATE app.reminders SET status='sent',sent_at=now() WHERE id=$1::uuid AND status='scheduled' RETURNING id,onboarding_id,recipient,sequence_number,sent_at),delivery AS (INSERT INTO app.email_deliveries(onboarding_id,reminder_id,purpose,recipient,provider_message_id,status,sent_at) SELECT onboarding_id,id,'missing_intake_reminder',recipient,$2,'sent',sent_at FROM updated RETURNING provider_message_id),audit AS (INSERT INTO app.audit_events(onboarding_id,event_type,title,detail,actor_type,actor_name,metadata) SELECT onboarding_id,'reminder.sent','Missing-item reminder sent','Reminder '||sequence_number||' was delivered through Gmail.','integration','Gmail',jsonb_build_object('provider_message_id',$2,'recipient',recipient) FROM updated RETURNING 1) SELECT provider_message_id FROM delivery;
